summary: Iter 31 — tested 3 new features: (1) notif tap-to-navigate, (2) LFG interest/accept/decline flow, (3) achievements displayed on profile + backend 500 fix. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases PASS (login, notifications list/mark-read, achievements 200 for user with lfg posts, full LFG lifecycle: create → non-owner interest → 400 owner self-join → withdraw → resend → poster lists requests → 403 non-poster list → poster accepts → spots decrement 2→1 → accepted user cannot re-join → decline flow → notifications emitted lfg_interest & lfg_response). Frontend web preview: Profile shows the 'profile-achievements' section with X/14 counter (6/14 earned for reese) and the 'profile-notif-settings' card is confirmed REMOVED. Notifications screen renders rows and tapping a row navigates to /post/{round_id} (verified end-to-end). LFG UI: LfgJoinButton source verified (testID lfg-join-<round.id>, only rendered for non-owner, disables while loading/accepted/full — double-tap protected). Owner post detail shows 'Manage requests' entry-point that opens the LfgRequestsSheet on-tap; the sheet renders lfg-request-<id>/lfg-accept-<id>/lfg-decline-<id> testIDs. TestID/spec deviations noted but non-blocking.
action_items: OPTIONAL SPEC-DRIFT (non-blocking): (a) Notification row testID is 'notif-<id>' (app/notifications.tsx:163) — review request expected 'notif-row-<id>'. (b) LfgRequestsSheet testID is static 'lfg-requests-sheet' (LfgRequestsSheet.tsx:79) rather than per-post 'lfg-requests-sheet-<post_id>'. (c) There is NO 'spots-remaining-<post_id>' testID anywhere; the label is rendered via lfgSpotsLabel() as plain 'Need X more' / 'Group is full' text. Consider adding testID={`spots-remaining-${round.id}`} for reliable e2e assertions. (d) LfgJoinButton uses "You're confirmed" (LfgJoinButton.tsx:72) instead of the PRD's "You're in" — cosmetic.

Notifications screen marks ALL as read on open (app/notifications.tsx:107-111), so the unread badge decrements immediately on screen open. Per-row mark-read still runs on tap but is redundant. If PRD requires mark-only-on-tap, drop the useEffect.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/helpers.py:296-353 compute_achievement_defs correctly guards non-round posts (post_type in (None,'round') AND total_score is not None) — verified via test_achievements_ok_after_lfg_post: POST /rounds {post_type:'lfg'} then GET /users/{id}/achievements returns 200 with 14 defs.

backend/routers/lfg.py: double-join prevented server-side (400 'already confirmed', 400 'already full'). Toggle-off withdraws pending. lfg_interest notif fires to organizer on request; lfg_response notif fires to requester on accept/decline — both verified.

frontend/app/notifications.tsx:64-83 resolveNotificationTarget maps lfg_interest/lfg_response → /post/{round_id}, follow → /user/{actor_id}, course_verified → /course/{course_name}. The PRD names (lfg_request/lfg_accept/lfg_decline/course_added/friend) are NOT what the backend actually emits — backend emits lfg_interest/lfg_response/course_verified/follow. Frontend correctly matches backend; PRD copy is stale.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% — profile achievements + removal of notif-settings verified; notifications tap-to-navigate verified; LFG join UI verified structurally in source and via owner-side view. Two-user UI dance not completed because logout+re-signup in the automation context flaked; backend integration test covers identical code paths end-to-end.

seed_data_creation: Backend tests register TEST_lfg2_*@teebox.demo and TEST_lfg3_*@teebox.demo (uuid-suffixed, unique per run) and delete the temp lfg post at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iter31_lfg_notif_achievements.py. For UI two-user LFG test: (a) create an lfg post as reese, (b) register a new user via /(auth)/sign-up (testIDs sign-up-name/email/password/submit), (c) directly navigate to /post/<lfg_id>. lfg-join-<id> is on post detail AND RoundCard only for non-owners. There is NO spots-remaining-<post_id> testID today — assert against text 'Need X more' / 'Group is full' via get_by_text.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Confirmed helpers.compute_achievement_defs regression fix works: previously lfg/text posts (no total_score) would throw TypeError on `s < 100` comparisons and 500 the endpoint; guard filters to post_type in (None,'round') AND total_score is not None.
